name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-registry-query-service
description: Answers whether a package exists in a built or live npm registry, searches package names by pattern, and looks up direct dependencies and dependents — cleanly, with a real not-found answer instead of a crash. Use when asking whether the firm has a package, or what depends on what, without deriving a whole graph.

scripts.verify: node --check src/query-npm-registry.mjs && node --check scripts/query-npm-registry.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
